comments: Input facts: ego and agent1 are cars; ego initiates by turning onto the trafficway occupied by responder agent1. Chosen assumptions: ego turns left from a lateral approach into agent1's outgoing lane. Agent1 proceeds straight on the receiving road, detects the completed entry, continues for a short reaction delay, then brakes continuously. The shared outgoing lane is required to distinguish turning into a path from crossing traffic. Speeds, initial distances, a nominal entry-time gap, and any response delay are chosen assumptions; no collision outcome is required.
